coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Across the seven ground-truth variable categories, training regime, game-rule comparison, and gameplay outcomes match broadly; evaluation controls and reasoning performance match partially. Giving half credit to each partial match yields 57%.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The design replaces LLaMA-2-7B and Baichuan-2-13B with a fixed LLaMA-3.2-1B model rather than varying the specified models. It does not vary learning rates and KL penalties across the specified training methods. It substitutes GSM8K/MATH for most required benchmarks, omits geometric mean scores, and does not specify the required fixed maximum sequence length of 2048. Its Taboo rules also introduce a chooser/forbidden-word structure rather than clearly specifying attacker-versus-defender play.
